cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
每天 3 颗星的桌面工具
五天后冲到日增 2,406
cover.dek: vercel-labs 的 agent-desktop 前 9 天每天只有 1 到 4 颗星,发布后几天里日增一路涨到 3,477,11 月 2 日见顶。它用无障碍树操控电脑,computer use 从浏览器走到了桌面。
cover.title_en:
From 3 stars a day
to 2,406 in under a week
cover.dek_en: vercel-labs' agent-desktop got 1 to 4 stars a day for its first nine days. After release it climbed to 3,477 a day and peaked on November 2. It drives the desktop through the accessibility tree, so computer use now reaches beyond the browser.

stickers.title: 数据新爆点
stickers.text: NVIDIA/auto-ontology 靠 HN 起量,282 分 138 评论,日增从 +25 涨到 +2,057。
stickers.text_en: NVIDIA/auto-ontology rose on HN with 282 points and 138 comments. Daily stars went from +25 to +2,057.

stickers.title: 记忆研究
stickers.text: 两篇新论文都发现,简单的记忆压缩和选择启发式并不可靠,编码任务上收益也不明显。
stickers.text_en: Two new papers find simple memory compression and selection heuristics unreliable, with little gain on coding tasks.

stickers.title: 新秀
stickers.text: agent-autoloop 11 月 3 日创建,首日 +1,492 星,让命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活。
stickers.text_en: agent-autoloop was created on November 3 and got +1,492 stars on day one. It lets CLI agents pick up work in the background.
